utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still a bit behind too—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: 4:30 still works for me, and I’m still sorting the donated tools and making the list of what’s left to fix.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — 4:30 still works, and thanks for sorting the tools. If you hear anything else that’s still needed, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as Vik sends the time. Thanks for being ready to help with the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll send the time tomorrow and keep repeating the Saturday repair drive plan to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Vik — once you send it tomorrow, I’ll spread the word right away. Thanks for keeping everyone in the loop!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus — I’m a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive. Want me to check what tools we’re missing or spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — could you check what we’re missing and spread the word if you can? I’m keeping the tools ready so we can knock out the loose shelf and wobbly chair first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep — I’ll check what we’re missing and let folks know. I’ll circle back once I’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send me the list when you have it, and I’ll take my part.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — appreciate it. Send it over when you can, and I’ll get on it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the list over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Hana — can you confirm the repair drive is still on for today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — it’s still on for today. I’m just checking the final time and supplies list, and I’ll send the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — can you confirm what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate it around the school pickup window, so we don’t end up short on volunteers — what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That window sounds perfect—let’s aim for right after school pickup. I’ll keep the supply list updated and make sure we’ve got the basics covered.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, right after pickup works for me—I’ll make sure we’ve got coverage lined up and keep an eye on volunteer timing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any supplies you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking the east end and the community bulletin board for any changes. If you’re heading out, the first place I’d like checked is the bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll check the bulletin board first and let you know if I see anything new.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo — I’m double-checking the time and place so we don’t end up with people at the wrong spot. If anything changes, please let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo — that really helps. I’m going to keep confirming the details so everyone lands in the right place with the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still available to help with the repair drive. What would you like me to bring or handle?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam — could you handle the most urgent repairs or bring any basic tools you have? I’m checking who’s free and will report back soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can handle the urgent repairs, and I’ll bring whatever basic tools I have on hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the porch light and kitchen faucet—does the gate latch need any special parts?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. If the gate latch needs parts, just let me know what to bring so we can keep it tidy and on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: If it’s just the latch screw or a hinge pin, that should do it — I’ll let you know if I find anything else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still a bit behind, but I’ll check the latest repair-drive update and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — I appreciate you checking. Even a small update helps keep the repair drive moving along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I’ll check the latest repair-drive update and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on today, and it’s been busy all morning—if you’re coming by, I’d head over soon so you don’t miss the good tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I’ll pass that along and tell folks to head to the community center soon. We want everyone to have a fair shot at the good tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — that’d be great. I’ll be there soon too and help keep things moving so everyone gets a fair shot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—just send me the final time and I’ll update the supply list right away. If anything else is missing, I’ll keep an eye out for it too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll send the final time as soon as I have it, and I’ll keep repeating the Saturday repair drive plan to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Vik — I’ll keep the supply list ready and watch for anything else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still catching up, Nell, but I’ll check the latest repair-drive details and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah — I’d appreciate that. I’m still a step behind too, so just let me know once you’ve got the update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do, Nell — I’ll check what’s latest and send you a quick update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’m heading over to sort the donated tools by the garage, and I’ll set aside any extra screwdriver for Tess if I find one.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks — that helps a lot. Let me know if you find anything else we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out for anything useful and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m still in for the repair drive, and I’ll watch for your time update tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Sam — I’ll keep things orderly and wait for Vik’s time update tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks — I’ll look out for Vik’s update tomorrow and be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s going steadily — I’m checking what’s most urgent and who’s free, then I’ll report back so we can keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — please send the urgent items and who’s free when you’ve got it, and I’ll confirm the time and supplies list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll send the urgent items and who’s free as soon as I’ve checked, and we’ll keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around the school pickup window, so we stay covered. What time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday at the community center works for me — what time fits best around pickup?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday afternoon would work best, maybe around 2 after pickup settles. That should keep us covered and still give us time to round up volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal — I’m a bit late, but I can still help with the repair drive. Want me to check what tools we’re missing or spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still watching the east end and the community bulletin board, and I’ll flag any location changes right away. If you can, check the bulletin board first and tell me what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll check the bulletin board first and let you know what’s missing. I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll grab the screwdriver set, wrench, flashlight, and check for tape and gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the repair drive is still on for today?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — it’s still on for today, and I’m heading over with the tools now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I can put you down for the repair drive and keep you posted as soon as I have the time. Thanks for helping out!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Quinn — I’m happy to help keep the repair drive organized. Just let me know what’s still needed and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Jules — that’s a huge help. I’ll send along the remaining details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m still on sorting the donated tools with Bo and sending the list once I’ve got it together. Tess, what would you like me to handle next for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Could you keep sorting and send that list when it’s ready? I’ll keep folks posted and tell them to come by soon so they don’t miss the good tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll keep sorting with Bo and send the list as soon as it’s ready. Thanks for keeping folks posted so they can get there in time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — yes, please put me down. I can bring my screwdriver set and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren — I’ve got you down, and your screwdriver set and flashlight will be really helpful. The repair drive is Sunday at the community center now, so I’ll make sure the updated details are shared.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll bring the screwdriver set and flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What still needs fixing most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly the small stuff that keeps people stuck — loose handles, leaky taps, and a few wobbly fixtures. We can chip away at it one bit at a time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I can start with the loose handles and wobbly fixtures. Just point me to the first one.
